messages:
mike: T-minus 2h until the EU change window. Quick sweep — docs, pins, smoke tests, rollback script?
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: release/v2.3 -> eu-1 in 1h55m. Reminder: freeze rules active in this window. :bell:
mike: Canaries are warmed in us-west, eu staging still initializing (10m to warm).
sara: Docs updated (release notes + upgrade notes). Confluence link posted. @caroline FYI on canary thresholds.
caroline: Canary thresholds set. 99p latency <250ms, error rate <0.5%. Staging numbers: 99p=180ms, errs=0.03%.
leo: Quick callout — yesterday's hotfix remains pinned to v2.2 on prod. We should avoid auto-unpin during freeze.
kim: Confirmed: auto-unpin disabled by freeze policy. Manual unpin requires 2 approvers and release-war-room signoff.
mike: Rollback script staged: `./scripts/rollback.sh release/v2.3` — tested in staging.
sara: Smoke suite running now: 12/12 green, one intermittent embeddings timeout (flaky), not blocking.
caroline: +1 for canary start. If we see error_rate >0.3% or latency jump >30% abort and fallback to v2.2.
deploy-bot: Canary initiated on eu-1 (5% traffic). Metrics streaming: error_rate=0.01%, tail latency +2ms.
mike: Dashboards look stable. tagging @ops-oncall to watch traces and pod restarts.
ops-oncall: I'm on it. Traces look normal, no OOMs, CPU steady at expected baselines.
sara: Reminder of freeze constraints: no DB migrations, no schema changes, only config toggles and revert-safe code.
leo: Also note cost throttle if embeddings spend breaches budget alert — that will auto-throttle traffic and we'll need manual intervention.
kim: If rollback is required, call `#release-war-room` and assign a rollback-owner. We have a standby: sam from infra.
mike: final go from infra/dev/ops? :thumbsup:
caroline: go from canary lead.
sara: go from docs.
ops-oncall: go from oncall.
mike: starting gradual traffic shift to 30% now.
deploy-bot: Traffic shift: 5% -> 30% over 4m. No anomalies detected.
leo: minor spike in embedding tail at minute 3 (20ms), returned to baseline.
caroline: keeping watch. Retain canary for 30m before wider rollout.
sara: publishing brief release note blurb now.
mike: agreed. If no regressions in 30m we continue to 60% then full.
ops-oncall: standing by for alerts. I will escalate immediately if SLOs breach.
kim: logged freeze exemption if we need to hotpatch — but that requires exec OK.
mike: thanks team. keeping this thread as the single source. ping me for any aborts or rollbacks.
deploy-bot: Canary health check passing (30m window): all green. Proceed when ready.
caroline: proceeding to 60% now.
deploy-bot: Traffic shift: 30% -> 60% over 7m. No anomalies.
mike: closing monitoring window; preparing post-launch notes and tagging stakeholders. :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: no incidents observed. Standdown in 1h unless anything pops.
leo: noting rollback-ready and artifacts pinned in s3 (build-2026-03-21-v2.2 and v2.3).
sara: release notes posted, changelog curated, customer comms queued.
kim: final reminder: keep the freeze policy enforced — no schema or infra changes until next change window.
mike: excellent, thank you all. moving to post-launch checklist in 30m.
